about: Examples for the Hanifi ↔ Rohingyalish converter (converter/transliterate.ts). See transliteration-examples.md for how to add and review entries. Only entries with status "verified" say anything about linguistic accuracy.

statuses.verified: Checked by fluent readers of both Hanifi and Rohingyalish. `rohingyalish` is the intended spelling of `hanifi`.
statuses.needs-review: Proposed example that has not been reviewed yet.
statuses.engine-snapshot: What the engine outputs today, recorded to detect unintended changes. NOT linguistically verified.

examples.source: Code points U+10D11 U+10D22: sakin (engine drops it: no Latin equivalent).
Code points U+10D17 U+10D1D U+10D19 U+10D1D: kinna wa / kinna ya (engine writes w / y, same as wa / ya).
Code points U+10D00 U+10D1E U+10D15: carrier letter A before a vowel (silent in Latin).
Code points U+10D00: carrier letter A alone (engine writes a).
Code points U+10D31 U+10D39 U+10D34 U+10D37: Hanifi digits.
